# cato_user (Resource)

Manages a local user. Directory-managed users cannot be imported or changed. Remote-access eligibility is not granted by this resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cato = { source = "catonetworks/cato" }
  }
}

variable "token" {
  type = string
  sensitive = true
  description = "API token supplied through TF_VAR_token."
}

variable "account_id" {
  type = string
  description = "Cato account ID supplied through TF_VAR_account_id."
}

provider "cato" {
  token = var.token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

resource "cato_user" "example" {
 email = "terraform-user@example.invalid"
 first_name = "Terraform"
 last_name = "Example"
 # enabled = false # Defaults to true; set false to disable the local user.
 # department = "Engineering"
 # job_title = "Developer"
 # phone_number = "+15555550123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email
- `first_name` (String) First name
- `last_name` (String) Last name

### Optional

- `department` (String) Department
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the local user is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `job_title` (String) Job title
- `phone_number` (String) Phone number

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Display name returned by the API
- `id` (String) Resource ID
- `user_import_type` (String) User source; only local users can be managed
- `user_status` (String) Current user status

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_user.example "123456"
```
